ex.en: The shop offers a two-year guarantee on all its electronic products.
ex.zh: 这家商店对所有电子产品提供两年保修。

words.note: 保障、保修常用 under guarantee；也接 that 从句。

ex.en: A strange odor filled the kitchen as soon as the gas was turned on.
ex.zh: 煤气一打开，厨房里就充满了奇怪的气味。

words.note: odor 多指不好闻的气味，美式拼写；英式拼作 odour。

ex.en: The new manager continued most of the policies introduced by her predecessor.
ex.zh: 新经理沿用了前任推出的大部分政策。

words.note: predecessor 反义词是 successor；pre- 表在前，指前任或前身。

ex.en: Children acquire language skills faster when they are exposed to books early.
ex.zh: 孩子早早接触书籍，语言能力会发展得更快。

words.note: acquire 强调经努力逐渐获得，比 get 正式，常接 skill、habit。

ex.en: A literal translation often fails to capture the humor of the original.
ex.zh: 直译往往无法传达原文的幽默。

words.note: literal 源自 letter（字母），指按字面；副词是 literally。

ex.en: He rejected the notion that money alone can buy happiness.
ex.zh: 他不认同仅靠金钱就能买到幸福的说法。

words.note: notion 指朦胧的看法或念头，比 idea 更书面。

ex.en: Several companies defaulted on their loans when the market collapsed.
ex.zh: 市场崩盘后，几家公司拖欠了贷款。

words.note: default on 表拖欠债务；计算机语境指默认设置。

ex.en: The ball rose in a graceful arc and dropped through the basket.
ex.zh: 球划出一道优美的弧线，落进篮筐。

words.note: arc 指圆周的一段；彩虹常被描述为 an arc of colors。

ex.en: The cafe serves hot beverages and light meals throughout the day.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆全天供应热饮和简餐。

words.note: beverage 是饮料的正式说法，多见于菜单和广告。

ex.en: The rebels held the journalists captive for nearly three weeks.
ex.zh: 叛军把记者们关押了将近三周。

words.note: be held captive 是常见被动结构；captive 作名词指俘虏。

ex.en: The constant noise from the building site nearly drove me insane.
ex.zh: 工地不断的噪音几乎把我逼疯了。

words.note: insane 与 crazy 近义但更正式；由 in- 加 sane（清醒的）构成。

ex.en: She attributes her success to hard work and a little luck.
ex.zh: 她把成功归因于努力加上一点运气。

words.note: 动词重音在后；attribute sth to sth，to 不能省略。

ex.en: The old cemetery at the edge of town is now a protected site.
ex.zh: 镇边那座老公墓如今成了保护区。

words.note: cemetery 结尾是 -tery，易与 symmetry 混淆。

ex.en: Scientists are studying the genetic causes of the disease.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研究这种疾病的遗传成因。

words.note: gene 是基因，genetic 为形容词，genetics 指遗传学。

ex.en: The doctor cleaned the cut and stitched it up in a few minutes.
ex.zh: 医生清理了伤口，几分钟就缝好了。

words.note: stitch up 表缝合；in stitches 是口语，指笑得前仰后合。

ex.en: The team returned home in triumph after winning the final.
ex.zh: 球队赢得决赛后凯旋而归。

words.note: triumph over 表战胜困难或对手；形容词是 triumphant。

ex.en: Gambling is a vice that has ruined many families.
ex.zh: 赌博是一种毁掉许多家庭的恶习。

words.note: vice 指恶习或罪恶；注意别与 vise（虎钳）混淆。

ex.en: Early detection of the disease greatly improves the patient's chances.
ex.zh: 及早发现这种疾病能大大提高患者的康复机会。

words.note: detect 是动词，detection 是名词；early detection 常用。

ex.en: A diet rich in fiber helps keep the bowels healthy.
ex.zh: 富含纤维的饮食有助于保持肠道健康。

words.note: bowel 常以复数出现，指肠道，多用于医学语境。

ex.en: His strange behavior aroused the suspicion of his neighbors.
ex.zh: 他古怪的举动引起了邻居的怀疑。

words.note: arouse 多接 interest、suspicion；arise 不及物。

ex.en: Plants grow best when the optimum temperature and moisture are maintained.
ex.zh: 保持最适宜的温度和湿度，植物生长得最好。

words.note: optimum 比 best 更书面，多修饰条件、温度、水平。

ex.en: She could hardly suppress a smile when she heard the news.
ex.zh: 听到这个消息时，她几乎忍不住笑了。

words.note: suppress 可用于情绪、消息或生长；名词是 suppression。

ex.en: My grandmother always made rice pudding for us on winter evenings.
ex.zh: 冬天晚上奶奶总会给我们做米布丁。

words.note: 英式 pudding 泛指甜点，美式多指布丁状甜食。

ex.en: She wrinkled her nose at the smell of the medicine.
ex.zh: 闻到药味，她皱起了鼻子。

words.note: wrinkle 作动词指皱起，作名词指皮肤或布料的褶皱。

ex.en: After hours of discussion, the group finally reached a consensus.
ex.zh: 经过数小时讨论，小组终于达成共识。

words.note: consensus 是名词，习惯说 reach a consensus on sth。

ex.en: The lecture was so boring that half the audience fell asleep.
ex.zh: 讲座乏味得让一半听众睡着了。

words.note: boring 修饰令人厌的事物；bored 表人感到无聊。

ex.en: Her reaction was a classic example of how stress affects judgment.
ex.zh: 她的反应是压力如何影响判断的典型例子。

words.note: classic 指经典或典型；classical 多指古典音乐和古典文化。

ex.en: Two experienced teachers supervise the students during the experiment.
ex.zh: 实验期间由两名有经验的老师指导学生。

words.note: supervise 强调监督并指导；由 super-（在上）加 vise（看）构成。

ex.en: She never joins in the office gossip about her colleagues.
ex.zh: 她从不参与办公室里关于同事的八卦。

words.note: gossip 可作名词和动词，指背后议论他人私事。

ex.en: He described the accident in detail to the police.
ex.zh: 他向警方详细描述了那起事故。

words.note: 习惯说 describe sth as sth，不用 describe sth like。
